paper_id: Li and Liu - 2010 - Iso-Map Energy-Efficient Contour Mapping in Wireless Sensor Networks
title: Iso-Map: Energy-Efficient Contour Mapping in Wireless Sensor Networks
venue: IEEE Transactions on Parallel and Distributed Systems
motivation: 传感器网络轮廓映射的全节点上报能耗过高,现实中Huanghua港每年疏浚监测费用高达1800万美元
problem_framing: 将网络流量从O(n)降至O(√n)的同时保持等值线图高保真度,且单节点计算开销保持常数
key_insight: 仅选择位于等值线上的'isoline节点'上报,等值线长度仅占区域周界,天然呈O(√n)规模
method_signature: Isoline节点选取+局部线性回归+梯度方向报告+Voronoi图Sink端等值线重构
evaluation_criteria: 网络流量开销、节点计算强度、保真度(Hausdorff距离)、能耗效率
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: 超过40%节点失效时方案不可用;节点密度低时保真度下降明显
evidence_for_taste: aggregation based protocols cannot further improve the scalability
the suppression algorithm ensures that the range spanned by suppressed nodes is bounded within the 2-hop neighborhood
More than 40 percent node failures make both of them unusable
such irregularity linearly increases (to the square root of the node density)
most of the nonbizarre curves have Hausdorff dimensions of 1
thinking_moves: 将感知问题重新框定为通信问题:通过选择而非全量上报来削减流量
利用几何测度证明流量上界:等值线长度类比于Hausdorff维度为1的曲线
引入梯度方向作为额外信息解决离散报告的歧义性
对标最坏情况建立理论下界,而非仅做经验比较
工程约束驱动参数选择:容忍度越大流量越省但等值线测量误差越大
